what: one temperature per exit, refit on the averaged weights. v6.0-VL's temperatures do not transfer: averaging shrinks the logits, and at v6.0-VL's temperatures the average is underconfident
fit: per exit L: logT_L = argmin over the grid -2..3 step .01 of the question-type-weighted NLL on the text rows of half A of the policy development set (the checkpoint's own DEV dump, 'cal' half, plus policy development set v1 text); image rows are not in the fit (rsijev/exit_policy.py fit_temperatures, run by select_exit_policy.py thresholds)
weights: w = p_EVAL(cell) / n_half(cell), cell = (mode, option-count bucket <=2 | 3-4 | 5-9 | >=10), as for v6.0-VL

exclusion.rule: every development case id that a member's training corpus contains, by case id or by state + first question, is dropped from every development dump before the fit (select_exit_policy.py overlap, exclude); corpora checked: domain-mix-2, domain-mix-1, image-corpus
exclusion.note: the own-DEV part is over-inclusive: those rows are held out of training by the same hash rule that defines the DEV split, so the fit leans on the held-out proxy rows. The corpora of the earlier stages (b-text-corpus, v6.0-VL's text-corpus and its ancestors) were not checked.

package.note: one temperature per exit and no other calibration buffers; the main exit's value is the same in both files (package_multiexit.py --temperatures)
